items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: I happened to love Doodles Weaver. Do you remember Doodles Weaver?

ctx.x: And at the time I’m not sure we even had a notion of what that was. Some of us wanted — you know like I wanted to play with Blood, Sweat & Tears or that kind of thing. And do you recall at that time setting goals? And what did “make it” mean for you?

No. I’ll tell you where I first heard jazz and this is kind of interesting. My sister, two years younger, was a fine artist and she could draw. And so Wyomissing is outside of Reading, PA. So whoever was coming into town in Reading she would do a portrait of, and then she would go and get it signed. Anyway I happened to love Doodles Weaver. Do you remember Doodles Weaver?
